B.fix: Add '* [Identity and trust boundary](#identity-and-trust-boundary)' between the Running natively and API overview TOC entries.

B.issue: Fix for the prior bounce-backend.sh finding (item 6) replaced it with 'docker compose -f docker/stack/dev.compose.yml up -d --force-recreate trade-imports-address-book', but trade-imports-address-book is not a service in any docker/stack/*.compose.yml — the command will fail with 'no such service'.
B.fix: Until the workspace stack integration lands (see item 5), drop this command or point it at the repo's own compose.yml / mvn spring-boot:run restart instead.

B.issue: AddressRequest's rewrite sets minLength: 0 on the required, @NotBlank fields (name, addressLine1, townOrCity, postcode, phone, email) — previously (6f1134b) they correctly declared minLength: 1; AddressRequest.java rejects blank values on all six with a 400. countryCode, also @NotBlank, was left at minLength: 1, showing the drop on the other six was accidental. assertSchemaPropertyNamesMatch only diffs property key sets, so this is invisible to OperatorComplianceIT.
B.fix: Set minLength: 1 on name, addressLine1, townOrCity, postcode, phone and email (matching @NotBlank and the pre-rewrite value); leave addressLine2/county (no @NotBlank) at minLength: 0.

B.issue: Problem and ValidationProblem schemas lost their required arrays in the rewrite. Prior (6f1134b) Problem declared required: [type, title, status] and ValidationProblem additionally required errors, matching Problem.java/ValidationProblem.java's @Schema(requiredMode = REQUIRED) annotations on type/title/status(/errors) — and the committed docs/openapi/operators.yml still carries required: [status, title, type] / required: [errors, status, title, type] for these exact schemas. The locked contract now declares neither, silently contradicting both the implementation and the file's own claimed equivalence to operators.yml. assertSchemaPropertyNamesMatch only diffs property key sets, so this drift is invisible to OperatorComplianceIT.
B.fix: Restore required: [type, title, status] on Problem and required: [type, title, status, errors] on ValidationProblem, matching operators.yml and the @Schema(requiredMode = REQUIRED) annotations.

B.issue: Fix commits weakened countryCode from minLength:1 to maxLength:2/minLength:0, newly making it disagree with AddressRequest's @NotBlank (which rejects an empty string with a 400) - the opposite of the direction item 27 asked for on the sibling fields
B.fix: Restore minLength: 1 on countryCode (keep the new maxLength: 2), matching @NotBlank + @Size(max=2), then regenerate with -Dopenapi.generate=true

B.issue: New Location header block (POST 201) documents the header as a 'Relative URI', but a relative URI in Location on 201 Created is non-conformant with RFC 9110; the doc now faithfully exposes a real defect in OperatorController.create, which builds the header via URI.create(...) instead of an absolute URI
B.fix: Fix OperatorController.create to build an absolute Location URI via ServletUriComponentsBuilder.fromCurrentRequest(), then update the header description here to 'Absolute URI of the created address' and regenerate with -Dopenapi.generate=true

B.issue: The class Javadoc still claims countryCode has 'no length ... check' (cv-011) but this diff adds @Size(max = 2), so the documented contract is now false and contradicts Address.java's correct cv-011 description (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
B.fix: Update the Javadoc to state countryCode is capped at 2 characters (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, cv-011) with no list check, matching Address.java's wording

B.issue: New updateEntity(AddressRequest, @MappingTarget Address) method (added this window to close the prior toEntity/toResponse update-path gap, item 40) has zero test coverage - OperatorMapperTest.java was not touched in this window, so nothing asserts it copies the 9 mutable fields onto an existing entity or leaves id/organisationId/status/createdAt/modifiedAt/version untouched.
B.fix: Add a test that maps a populated AddressRequest onto a pre-existing Address via updateEntity, asserting the 9 client fields are overwritten and id/organisationId/status/createdAt/modifiedAt/version keep their original entity values.

B.issue: New handleOptimisticLocking (@ExceptionHandler OptimisticLockingFailureException → 409 conflict) has no unit test, unlike the sibling HttpMessageNotReadable handler added in the same delta; without coverage a regression can silently fall through the RuntimeException catch-all to 500.
B.fix: Add a GlobalExceptionHandlerTest case asserting handleOptimisticLocking returns 409 application/problem+json with type .../conflict, fixed detail, camelCase traceId and no errors map.

B.issue: New OptimisticLockingFailureException handler emits 409 conflict (type https://api.cdp.defra.cloud/problems/conflict) but docs/openapi/api-contract.locked.yaml declares no 409 on update-address (or delete-address), so concurrent @Version save conflicts are a live wire status absent from the locked contract.
B.fix: Add a 409 Problem response to update-address (and any other mutating op that saves an @Version Address) in api-contract.locked.yaml, documenting the conflict problem type and detail.

B.issue: The comment above the new springdoc block says '/v3/api-docs stays enabled everywhere', but the code directly below it sets api-docs.enabled: false in the base config (it's now only re-enabled via application-local.yml and application-integration-test.yml overrides) -- the comment now says the opposite of what the code does.
B.fix: Rewrite the comment to describe the actual behaviour: api-docs and swagger-ui are both disabled by default in application.yml and explicitly re-enabled per-profile in application-local.yml (local dev) and application-integration-test.yml (OperatorComplianceIT).

B.issue: The class Javadoc still claims countryCode is 'presence-only (@NotBlank, no length or list check — cv-011), so there is no over-length country case', but this commit added countryCodeRejectsValuesLongerThanTwoCharacters (line 114) which proves the opposite — AddressRequest.countryCode now carries @Size(max = 2) and a 3-char value is rejected.
B.fix: Update the class Javadoc to describe the current @Size(max = 2) contract (matching the sibling type/role paragraph style) instead of the stale presence-only claim.

B.issue: New test typeMismatch_returns400BadRequestProblemNamingTheParameter duplicates the reflection-on-setUp MethodParameter-building anti-pattern already flagged for the validationException helper (item 122) - it calls GlobalExceptionHandlerTest.class.getDeclaredMethod("setUp") inline, a second place that breaks with an unrelated NoSuchMethodException if the @BeforeEach is renamed
B.fix: Reflect on a dedicated placeholder method (e.g. a private no-op declared next to validationException) instead of getDeclaredMethod("setUp") directly in this test

B.issue: Refresh removed searchMatchesTownOrCityAndPostcodeButNotAddressLineFields; no remaining IT proves q matches townOrCity/postcode or that addressLine1 is excluded — dropping those $regex clauses from searchByQuery / searchByQueryAndCountryCode leaves only the name-based partialWordSearchMatchesNameCaseInsensitively green.
B.fix: Restore a test that seeds distinct town-, postcode-, and addressLine1-only hits (e.g. town Greenwich, postcode GREEN1 2AB, addressLine1 'Green Lane…') and asserts totalItems 2 with hasItem on the town and postcode ids only.

B.issue: Regeneration was moved to a separate @EnabledIfSystemProperty test (partial fix for item 159), but apiDocsMatchTheCommittedArtifactAndTheLockedContract still early-returns when -Dopenapi.generate=true — now without writing the artifact — so the staleness and divergence gates still silently disappear on that flag.
B.fix: Remove the early-return branch entirely from the assertion test; regeneration already lives in regenerateCommittedOpenApiArtifact.

B.issue: New assertSchemaPropertyNamesMatch fails open: returns without asserting when either doc lacks components (lines 274-276), and skips a schema's property-key check unless BOTH sides expose a Map 'properties' node (lines 286-291) — so components missing, or locked-with-properties vs live-without, leaves the new Critical schema gate green
B.fix: Assert components/schemas are non-null (AssertJ), and treat a missing/non-Map properties node as an empty map so property-key-set equality always runs

B.issue: publishMetrics_shouldSkipNonFiniteValues sets up one finite and one NaN measurement but its only assertion is verify(mockMeter).measure() — this passes identically even if the isFinite check in EmfMetricsPublisher.publishMetrics is deleted, so the test does not actually verify that NaN values are skipped
B.fix: Assert the skip behaviour directly, e.g. extract the finite-value filter into a small package-visible/static method (or inject a mockable metrics sink so putMetric can be verified as called once with the finite metric key and never with the NaN one)
